title: imap: AUTH=PLAIN authentication handler
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/auth.rs. Handle CommandAuthenticateReceived when mechanism == PLAIN. Algorithm: (1) if initial_response is Some, decode base64 now; else call server.authenticate_continue('+') and wait for AuthenticateDataReceived; (2) decode base64 from client: bytes split on 0x00 -> [authzid (ignored), authcid, passwd]; (3) call credential_store.check(authcid, passwd).await; (4) if ok: call server.authenticate_finish(Status::ok(tag, None, 'Authentication successful')); transition session to Authenticated { username: authcid }; (5) if fail: call server.authenticate_finish(Status::no(tag, None, 'Authentication failed')); do NOT update session state. Defensive: base64 decode errors -> authenticate_finish(no); null bytes missing -> authenticate_finish(bad); password never logged.
